messages:
jess_support: heads up — customer 'acme-pay' on Private VPC deployment hitting backend 502s and timeouts since ~18:30 UTC. They report API calls fail intermittently, and our logs show TLS handshake errors to their KMS endpoint. I already escalated to them, they changed no infra.

maria_netops: can you paste the exact error from our side? is this only through the DX/DirectConnect peer or also IPsec tunnels?

jess_support: primary path is Direct Connect (aws dx), fallback IPsec tunnel triggers when dx flap. Errors in proxy logs: 

```
2026-03-16T18:32:05Z proxy ERROR upstream TLS handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-16T18:32:07Z proxy WARN backend unreachable: dial tcp 10.10.50.4:443: i/o timeout
```

They also see DNS resolution failures for kms.acme-pay.internal right before the handshake error.

alex_sre: tagging @maria_netops — suspect egress allowlist or MTU causing TCP MSS/window issues on fallback. Can you run a traceroute+tcpdump from one of the Private nodes when this happens?

jess_support: running now — attaching outputs.

```
# traceroute to kms.acme-pay.internal (10.10.50.4)
traceroute to 10.10.50.4 (10.10.50.4), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1 10.0.1.1 0.64 ms 0.50 ms 0.43 ms
 2 172.31.255.1 1.23 ms 1.11 ms 1.09 ms
 3 DX-GW-1 5.82 ms 5.74 ms 5.70 ms
 4 192.0.2.10 12.21 ms 12.18 ms 12.10 ms
 5 10.10.50.4 12.45 ms 12.40 ms 12.38 ms
```

```
# tcpdump snippet (during failure)
15:32:05.123456 IP 10.0.2.5.52344 > 10.10.50.4.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 1234 ecr 0,nop,wscale 7], length 0
15:32:05.223123 IP 10.10.50.4.443 > 10.0.2.5.52344: Flags [S.], seq 100, ack 1, win 29200, options [mss 1400,sackOK,TS val 4321 ecr 1234], length 0
15:32:05.323333 IP 10.0.2.5.52344 > 10.10.50.4.443: Flags [F.], seq 1, ack 101, win 64240, length 0
```

Observation: remote MSS advertised lower (1400) and we see a FIN right after SYN/SYN-ACK.

maria_netops: weird — DX link MTU should be 1500 and we haven't rolled any changes. Could be path MTU blackhole when falling back to IPsec (ESP overhead). Are IPsec tunnels doing DF clearing / MSS clamp?

sam_engineer: customer confirmed they recently rotated KMS certs and their KMS is behind a load balancer that enforces TLS1.3 only. Our proxy uses TLS1.2 for that backend in Private mode unless the route is to dedicated LB. Could be a protocol mismatch + connection reset from LB.

alex_sre: two parallel hypotheses: 1) when DX flap occurs we hit IPsec path that reduces MTU and no MSS clamp causes handshake fail; 2) TLS mismatch with new cert/ALPN causing immediate close. We need to isolate which.

jess_support: customer's DNS logs show intermittent NXDOMAIN for kms.acme-pay.internal at 18:31:58 then success 3s later. Could be DNS cached IP pointing to old LB that doesn't accept TLS1.3.

sre-bot: AUTO: created incident INC-2026-032-47, paging oncall.

maria_netops: action items: (1) temporarily enable MSS clamping at 1350 on the IPsec egress on our side, (2) add kms.acme-pay.internal to test allowlist and force route via DX only to see if issue disappears, (3) ask customer to confirm LB supports TLS1.2 fallback for a short window.

alex_sre: I'll push MSS clamp on one node now: `ip route change default via 172.31.255.1 mtu 1410` then `iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1350` — testing in blue pool.

jess_support: applied to blue pool at 18:46 UTC. customer reports reduced 502s for ~10min but then errors resumed at 19:05.

sam_engineer: customer just confirmed LB dropped TLS1.2 support last week and they didn't flag us. They can re-enable for 30m window. If re-enable removes errors while on IPsec, then TLS mismatch is culprit.

alex_sre: ok toggle LB to allow TLS1.2 for 30m now? @acme-pay

jess_support: confirmed — LB re-enabled TLS1.2 at 19:12 UTC. Errors stopped immediately; no more NXDOMAIN either.

maria_netops: that suggests race of DNS->old IP (LB) + TLS protocol mismatch causing resets. Follow-up: request customer to (a) add our DC endpoint IP to their LB allowlist to avoid DNS drift during rotations; (b) ensure LB supports TLS1.2 for compatibility or rotate clients to TLS1.3; (c) we will keep MSS clamp enabled on IPsec fallback for 48h and monitor.

jess_support: logging summary and repro steps sent to customer. I'll include traceback, traceroute, tcpdump, and the config change we applied.

logbot: NOTE: incident INC-2026-032-47 created by sre-bot; priority P2; owners alex_sre, maria_netops.

alex_sre: closing loop — I'll open a postmortem draft and schedule a sync with acme-pay to coordinate KMS/LB cert rotations. Anything else?

jess_support: nothing else, closing here. :white_check_mark:
